snippet.title: Urban Supermarket Simulator - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Escalators up, profits up! Step into the management world of your Urban Supermarket, bake fresh bread, fold the racks, restock aisles, and get ready for the rush. Hire employees, expand departments, and grow into a two-floor hypermarket.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819640/Urban_Supermarket_Simulator/

And Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850080/Urban_Supermarket_Simulator_Demo/
